stem: The dot plot shows a data set of 9 values. What is the range of the data set?
solution: The range is the greatest value minus the least value.
The greatest value is 10 and the least is 4, so the range is \(10 - 4 = 6\).
verify:
v = figure['values']
assert len(v) == 9
r = max(v) - min(v)
assert r == 6
assert Rational(spr_answers[0]) == r and len(spr_answers) == 1
